title: feat(nm2readslz): neighbor-read of M at t+1 on two-axis same-lock z-probes: reverse HOLD, face HOLD
science: Two-axis same-lock seed, z-probes, neighbor-read of M: HOLDs at all four probes. Names the mechanism explicitly - the match at A is the partner SEED (0,1,1) carrying the identical letter +e_2, whereas on the opposite seed the partner letter is -e_2 and the read fails. The verdict is therefore decided by the seed-letter convention at a pair of adjacent tick-0 seeds, not by any formation event.
